subject.title: Add message history retrieval action to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported cross-channel message-history capability, and if so should it expose only OpenClaw-observed retained messages or also provider-native history where a channel plugin can safely support it?
rationale: The request adds a new agent-visible data-access capability with privacy, authorization, storage, and uneven channel-provider semantics; current outbound message-action documentation does not determine the intended contract.

options.title: Define an observed-history capability
options.body: Add a generic read-only contract limited to messages OpenClaw has received and retained, with explicit access policy and channel-plugin implementations.

options.title: Keep history retrieval plugin-owned
options.body: Document that channel-specific archive or history tools should ship as code plugins until a shared retained-message contract has a sponsor.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep the current outbound-only message tool and revisit after passive inbound archival and retention policy are settled.

recommendation.title: Define an observed-history capability
recommendation.body: Add a generic read-only contract limited to messages OpenClaw has received and retained, with explicit access policy and channel-plugin implementations.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core-versus-plugin and privacy-contract choice rather than a narrow Telegram implementation detail.
